verdict.score_rationale: The board sits between the flat 5 anchor and the unfinished 6 anchor: its flow is readable and deliberately sectioned, but pervasive generic process boxes, oversized empty bands, and a few awkwardly routed connections keep it from feeling pin-up finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Four horizontal regions organize the frame, but the query and model-change sections contain large unexplained empty bands, with the final section especially sparse on its right side.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Teal processes, yellow decisions and notes, and green/red branch paths are legible and mostly consistent, though the near-universal teal treatment does little to distinguish operational roles.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Most routing is clean, but the opposing retry arrowheads and the very long dashed magenta feedback loop read as exposed routing mechanics rather than polished flow.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Peer boxes generally share sizes and registers, but spacing varies widely across sections and the operational vocabulary is largely reduced to identical plain rounded boxes instead of role-specific icons.
